result: No single fix is urgent. Start with #1: a failed copy during cut still deletes the selection, which is the only finding that loses user content. I found 15 issues by reading the code, ranked below by severity. I could not run any tests because `node_modules` is not installed, so everything here comes from static reading. No files were modified. Paths are relative to `packages/excalidraw/` unless the path starts with `packages/` (#11). ## High: data loss and untrusted input 1. **Cut deletes elements even when the copy fails** - Location: `actions/actionClipboard.tsx:117-120` - Cause: - `actionCopy.perform(...)` is not awaited and its result, including `errorMessage`, is discarded. - Ctrl+X always passes `event = null`. `actions/manager.tsx:141-145` sends `null` and calls `preventDefault` on the keydown; I believe that suppresses the native `cut` event, but I have not checked it in a browser. - The copy therefore always goes through `navigator.clipboard.writeText`. If that rejects (Firefox without HTTPS, unfocused document, denied permission), the elements are deleted, the clipboard is stale and no error is shown. - Fix: make `perform` async and await the copy. If the copy returns `appState.errorMessage`, return that result and skip `actionDeleteSelected`. 2. **`files` in pasted JSON skip all image validation** - Location: `clipboard.ts:542-546`, `components/App.tsx:4671`, `components/App.tsx:5326-5363`, `packages/element/src/image.ts:30` - Cause: - Any `text/plain` JSON with `type: "excalidraw/clipboard"` supplies `files`, and they are added as-is. - There is no `dataURL` scheme check, no MIME allowlist and no `maxFileSizeBytes` check. - A `dataURL` of `https://…` goes straight into `image.src`. That causes a remote request for the user, for collaborators and for anyone who later opens the scene. It also taints the canvas, so PNG export throws. - A `null` entry throws on `fileData.id` after `replaceAllElements` has already run. - Fix: validate each file before `addMissingFiles`. Require an object with a string `id`, a `dataURL` starting with `data:image/`, a MIME type in `IMAGE_MIME_TYPES`, and a size within `imageOptions.maxFileSizeBytes`. Drop anything else. 3. **Pasted HTML triggers automatic fetches of arbitrary URLs** - Location: `clipboard.ts:221-225`, `components/App.tsx:4985-4988`, `data/blob.ts:422-445` - Cause: - Every `` in the clipboard HTML is fetched without asking the user. - There is no cap on the number of URLs and no timeout. - `response.blob()` reads the whole body before any size check. - `startsWith("http")` also matches schemes other than http and https. - Fix: parse with `new URL` and allow only `http:` and `https:`. Cap the URL count, add an `AbortController` timeout, and reject on `Content-Length` above `maxFileSizeBytes`. 4. **The paste pipeline has no error handling** - Location: `components/App.tsx:4760-4815`, `actions/actionClipboard.tsx:91-93` - Cause: - `pasteFromClipboard` is async and has no try/catch. - `actionPaste` calls it without `await`, so its `asyncPasteFailedOnParse` catch only sees synchronous `createPasteEvent` errors. - `elements: [null]` throws in `arrayToMap` at `data/restore.ts:962`. Malformed API skeletons passed to `convertToExcalidrawElements` are not validated and likely throw as well. - The result is an unhandled rejection with no message, and the tool is not reset. - Fix: wrap the body in try/catch and set `errorMessage`. `await` the call in `actionPaste`. Make `clipboardContainsElements` require every entry to be an object with a string `type`. 5. **Paste does not filter files down to supported images** - Location: `clipboard.ts:436-442`, `components/App.tsx:4639-4657` - Cause: - `getFiles()` only checks `kind === "file"`, but its type guard claims the result is an image file. - The drop path filters with `isSupportedImageFile` at `components/App.tsx:13239-13241`; the paste path does not. - Pasting a copied PDF or `.excalidraw` file inserts placeholder elements, shows an error, and leaves deleted elements plus a history entry. - The accompanying text is ignored, and the `dataTransferFiles.length === 0` mixed-content branch is skipped. - Fix: filter with `isSupportedImageFile` at the top of `insertClipboardContent`. Fall through to elements or text when no images remain. ## Medium 6. **`readSystemClipboard` fallback is wired to the wrong error** - Location: `clipboard.ts:262-293` - Cause: - The `DataError` (empty clipboard) check reads the shadowed `readText` error, and only when `navigator.clipboard.read` is missing, so it never runs for a real `read()` failure. - An empty clipboard therefore shows the `asyncPasteFailedOnRead` dialog. - A `NotAllowedError` from `read()` still calls `readText()`, which means a second `readText()` call and possibly a second permission prompt in Safari (not verified). - When `navigator.clipboard` is undefined, the `for…of` loop throws a `TypeError`. - The first warning text (line 268) is wrong: `read()` failed, not `readText()`. - Fix: inspect the outer error first. Return `{}` for `DataError`, rethrow `NotAllowedError` and `AbortError` without falling back, and guard for a missing `navigator.clipboard?.read`. 7. **`copyText` error handling never runs** - Location: `actions/actionClipboard.tsx:264-268` - Cause: - `copyTextToSystemClipboard` is async and is not awaited, so the try/catch never fires and failures become unhandled rejections. - `components/ShareableLinkDialog.tsx:37` has the same kind of problem: it sets `justCopied` even after a failure. - Fix: make `perform` async, `await` the call, and return `appState.errorMessage`. Move `setJustCopied(true)` inside the `try`. 8. **Clipboard code ignores the editor's owner document** - Location: `clipboard.ts:62-72, 263, 567, 626, 647-677`, `data/blob.ts:453` - Cause: - The code uses the global `navigator`, `window` and `document`, while `App` uses `ownerDocument` and `ownerWindow`. Commit `e1bb9ff8` added render-into-another-document and left `clipboard.ts` untouched. - In a popup host, clipboard reads and writes run against the unfocused opener document and likely reject with "document not focused" (not run in a popup host). - The `execCommand` fallback appends its textarea to the wrong document. - `instanceof DataTransferItem` fails across realms, so file handles are lost. - Fix: pass `ownerWindow` and `ownerDocument` into the clipboard helpers. Duck-type the item check with `"getAsFileSystemHandle" in item`. 9. **`preventDefault` runs after awaits** - Location: `components/App.tsx:4813`, and skipped entirely on the early return at `components/App.tsx:4800` - Cause: event dispatch has finished by the time the awaits resolve, so the call has no effect and the default action and host-page handlers still run. - Fix: call `event.preventDefault()` synchronously right after the guards, before line 4791. 10. **Copy and cut take over the clipboard outside the canvas** - Location: `components/App.tsx:4474-4502` - Cause: - The guard only checks that focus is inside the container and the target is not writable. - Ctrl+C on text selected in a dialog or error message writes element JSON instead of the text. - With nothing selected it overwrites the system clipboard with `{"type":"excalidraw/clipboard","elements":[]}`. - Fix: return early when `ownerWindow.getSelection()` is non-collapsed, or when no elements are selected. ## Low 11. **Copied text contains auto-wrap line breaks** - Location: `packages/element/src/textElement.ts:579-581`, used by `actions/actionClipboard.tsx:265` and `wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.tsx:584` - Cause: the code reads `element.text`, which is the wrapped version, instead of `originalText`. - Fix: push `element.originalText`. 12. **Same-type clipboard images overwrite each other** - Location: `clipboard.ts:258, 295-306, 105-110` - Cause: - `types` is keyed by MIME type, so a second `image/png` item replaces the first. - `files.push` also mutates the caller's array. - Fix: collect files into an array and copy it before pushing. 13. **Mixed-content paste drops content silently** - Location: `components/App.tsx:4977-5017`, `clipboard.ts:221-225` - Cause: - Text is discarded whenever any image is present. - `data:` image sources are skipped. - If the image tool is unsupported, nothing happens and there is no `imageToolNotSupported` error, unlike `components/App.tsx:4654`. - Fix: insert both text and images, accept `data:image/` sources, and show the error. 14. **Copy-as-SVG likely loses user activation in Safari (not verified)** - Location: `data/index.ts:155-161` - Cause: the code awaits `svgPromise` before calling `writeText`. The PNG path avoids this with a Promise-based `ClipboardItem` (`clipboard.ts:557-571`). - Fix: write a `ClipboardItem` whose `text/plain` value is a promise. 15. **`IS_PLAIN_PASTE` is a module global with mismatched timers** - Location: `components/App.tsx:628-630, 3335, 5637, 5641` - Cause: - The flag is shared by every editor instance. - The timer is set with `ownerWindow.setTimeout` but cleared with the global `clearTimeout`, which can cancel an unrelated timer in the main window. - Fix: make it an instance field and clear it with `this.ownerWindow.clearTimeout`. Next: open `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionClipboard.tsx:117` and read `actionCut`; it is a four-line fix.
